vigil_assessment.factual_basis: Business Insider and TechRadar report that Anthropic declared a major outage on 7 April 2026 affecting Claude.ai and Claude Code. TechRadar preserved provider statements identifying login, voice and chat errors on desktop and mobile. Business Insider reported that Claude API and Cowork remained operational and that Anthropic applied a fix and restored normal success rates roughly 90 minutes after the disruption began; TechRadar's timestamped updates place the identified-to-fix window at about 56 minutes.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: The occurrence demonstrates successful scope separation under degraded conditions: the provider status distinguished unavailable user and coding surfaces from operational API and Cowork components. That distinction supports targeted recovery and avoids falsely converting partial service degradation into a single undifferentiated access state. The unresolved governance issue is ordinary service resilience, for which the current selectable taxonomy does not supply a mechanism class on this evidence. The successful invariant is bounded to component-scope differentiation during the observed partial service loss, without validating reliability or asserting a cause. Recovery context does not create another mapping or merge the previous-day event. Independent external assessment supports source-bounded repair in the restoration stage. The stakeholder communication-plan outcome remains Boundary because its complete planning evidence is unavailable. The SDOS governance-degradation candidate is excluded on its specific trigger or publication timing, rather than voluntary status.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: This incident is a useful negative control for access-state classification. A multi-component outage can be operationally significant without an Access-State Differentiation failure, while accurate component labelling supports its bounded successful invariant when the provider keeps affected and unaffected surfaces legible. CAM should preserve component-level status, recovery timing and dependency boundaries while avoiding taxonomy inflation from outage severity alone.
